title: Odoo 1 - everything matches
scenario: Deccan Poultry Farms bills PO A: 50 kg at Rs 180, all 50 kg received. Approved, and posted to Odoo as a draft bill linked to PO A.

title: Odoo 2 - billed more than received
scenario: Godavari Fresh Fish bills 40 kg of prawns on PO B, but only 30 kg have been received. Held until the rest arrives.

title: Odoo 3 - rate 16% above the PO
scenario: Godavari Fresh Fish bills 20 kg of rohu on PO C at Rs 220 against Rs 190 on the PO: beyond the 10% band, so rejected.

title: Odoo 4 - the same invoice again
scenario: Case 1 sent again as a reminder. Rejected as a duplicate, by Invoice Flow and by Odoo, which already has bill DPF-2001.

title: Odoo 5 - PO not in Odoo
scenario: Deccan Poultry Farms cites PO P00099, which doesn't exist in Odoo. Held until the right PO is given.
